recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: twenty-six years of playstation silicon finally laid bare
forward-deployed engineers recruiting at the startup frontier
september fog settling over the pacific coast
overcast gold hour before sunset at nineteen-fifteen
agents spun up from a pocket-sized shortcut

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Crack layered security chips by hitting pulse windows — each breach peels back a neon circuit trace like vintage console hardware coming alive.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: every cracked layer triggers a satisfying phosphor reveal in under a minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: pulse windows shrink and decoy nodes multiply with each layer breached

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Part autumn fog with your finger to expose hidden bridge silhouettes before the mist seals shut — a one-screen reveal puzzle driven by wind.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: completing a silhouette feels like clearing a window onto the bay
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: wind speed rises and fog reforms faster as silhouettes grow more intricate

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Route parallel agent tasks into matching lanes — surgical edits left, sweeping plans right — before mismatched jobs collide and break flow.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: lanes merging cleanly delivers a tiny dopamine hit of orchestrated order
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: new agent types spawn faster and lanes narrow as the queue deepens

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick tour gear crates onto a dawn-bound truck before sunrise — weight, bounce, and awkward shapes make every load a physics puzzle.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: the last crate sliding into place as the sky lightens from overcast to gold
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: heavier equipment, a shrinking truck bed, and a ticking dawn timer
